description: Payload errors of a DecryptedTransaction as the ring rpc serializes them. kinds names every OutputPayloadErrorKind. foreign_body_and_low_order_key holds the errors of one delivered transfer whose slot 2 body opens to another commitment under the published recipient key and whose slot 5 publishes a recipient key without an X25519 agreement. Pinned by the custom-rings/client rpc tests and decoded by the TypeScript RingRpc tests.
